checkpoints.name: buggy_idles_while_enable_high
checkpoints.description: During the t=22..200 ns window enable is high. The golden counter increments every cycle; the buggy counter (gated on ~enable) stays at 0x00. This is the moment a waveform diff first lights up.

checkpoints.name: buggy_counts_while_enable_low
checkpoints.description: When enable drops to 0 at t=200 ns, the buggy counter starts incrementing (~enable = 1). The golden counter is paused here.

checkpoints.name: buggy_stops_again_with_enable_high
checkpoints.description: At t=300 ns enable returns to 1; the buggy counter freezes at the value it reached (0x0A) and never advances again before the simulation ends. The golden counter resumes incrementing from this point.
